design.purpose: A free-standing outdoor planter for herbs or flowers, with drainage through a 2 cm slot between the base slats. Built sizes assume the estimated board sizes are confirmed before cutting.

steps.c: Confirm each board measures before marking any cuts
Mark then saw across into the listed lengths
Place the second board flat for marking
Mark then saw across into the listed lengths
Place the narrow board flat for marking
Mark then saw across into the listed lengths
Sand cut edges and faces until splinter-free
Lay the front base slat flat on the ground
Lay the back slat parallel, leaving the drainage gap
Stand the front side against the front slat edge
Stand the back side against the back slat edge
Stand the left side on both slats between long sides
Stand the right side on both slats between long sides
Check corners square and tops level before fastening
Fasten the front-left corner through the front side
Fasten the front-right corner through the front side
Fasten the back-left corner through the back side
Fasten the back-right corner through the back side
Fasten the front base slat through the front side
Fasten the back base slat through the back side
Remove clamps and sand any remaining rough spots
